name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
one_liner: A command-line tool that lets an AI agent open a real web browser, read the page like a screen reader, and click or type on it, so the AI can actually use websites the way a person does.
buyer: A small agency or ops team that needs to automate repetitive web tasks (filling forms, checking competitor prices, scraping listings) without hiring a developer to maintain fragile scrapers.
business_use_cases: A market-research agency builds a paid service that uses it to monitor competitor pricing and stock across dozens of e-commerce sites daily.
A recruiting agency automates posting job listings to multiple job boards that have no shared API, cutting hours of manual copy-paste work per client.
A QA consultancy offers automated end-to-end testing of client websites as a subscription, driven by agent scripts instead of brittle traditional test suites.

money_ideas.idea: Managed 'web task automation' service for small businesses who need recurring scraping or form-filling done reliably
Pay-per-job automation gigs (price monitoring, lead scraping, listing uploads) sold on freelance platforms

steal_this: Build a small daily competitor-price tracker for a local retailer using this tool and sell it as a cheap weekly report.
